question.text: Let <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo>:</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">z</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn></math> and <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo>:</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">z</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn></math> be two planes. Let <math><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mn>5</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> and <math><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mn>8</mn></mrow></mfenced><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi></math> be two points in space. The equation of plane <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math> through the line of intersection of <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math> and <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> such that the length of the projection upon it of the line segment <math><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></math> is the least, is

solution.text:
Equation of plane P3 is P1+λP2=0
x1+λ+y1-2λ+z2+λ=3+4λ
AB→=<2,-1,3>
Length of projection of AB→ on plane is least
⇒AB→ must be perpendicular to the plane
⇒1+λ2=1-2λ-1=2+λ3⇒λ=1
So, the equation of the plane is 2x-y+3z=7
